messages:
alex: Heads-up — dock 3 blocked, incoming consignment (8x H100) arrived with crushed pallet and exposed units. photos uploaded. AWB: `AWB1234567890`. Need RMA routing decision + whether vendor will cover transit damage.

maria: Ack. Tagging @natalie (vendor) and @raj for quick triage. Any DOA count yet?

raj: Quick triage done in staging. Powered 2 units: 1 POST fail, 1 boots but heavy gouges on heatsink shroud. Still capturing serials.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-3172: "H100 consignment damage at FRA depot" — assigned to @emily.

emily: Oncall here. Can vendor accept depot RMA pickup or do we need crossdock replacement to DE refurb? If replacement, ETA matters.

natalie (vendor): Sorry for the trouble. We can accept depot repair OR express exchange from our DE pool. For exchange we need: AWB, photos, packing list, and signed RMA form. Transit damage is handled case-by-case; carrier PIR + invoice required for credit. If you want express swap, we can prioritize once RMA approved.

alex: Photos & quick evidence: https://redwood-s3/photos/1745551239/awb_AWB1234567890.jpg. Serials (partial): `H100-1001,H100-1002,H100-1003,H100-1004`. Full list attached in drive.

maria: Finance question — do we provision a provisional credit to ops or wait for vendor/carrier claim? @luis

luis: Open the carrier claim first. We can provision a contingent credit but need vendor-signed RMA + carrier PIR + CA invoice to finalize. Save everything in the claim folder.

raj: Operational note — we've quarantined 2 racks (for thermal/firmware safety) and re-routed scheduled jobs. This reduces available EU pool by ~12% for next 24h. Need to shift some capacity from US pool if replacements delayed.

alex: If vendor ETA > 10 business days, can supply team air-ship loaners? What's budget for air uplift vs waiting for warranty replacement?

natalie (vendor): We can do express replacement from DE pool, ETA 4-6 business days after RMA approval. For air uplift we need to confirm billing party; standard transit damage is usually claimed with the carrier — vendor can prioritize exchange but billing depends on contract terms. I'll escalate warranty-vs-transit to our logistics lead.

emily: Action items: 1) Vendor to send RA form & confirm pickup timeline (natalie) 2) Ops to upload full photo set + packing list + serials (alex/raj) 3) Finance to open carrier claim and mark provisional credit rules (luis) 4) Supply to provision loaner plan if ETA >72h (maria). I'll update INC-2026-3172 and post status.

alex: Uploaded packing list & full serials to \nhttps://redwood-drive/procurement/claims/AWB1234567890 and added carrier PIR template.

maria: Noted. I'll start loaner routing estimate and check reserved capacity for 48–72h.

raj: Small config note: we disabled automatic KV cache warm for those racks until hardware sorted to avoid stale states.

alex: Thanks all. Natalie — please DM your logistics contact and cc ops email when RMA form ready. :thumbsup:

natalie (vendor): Will do, expect RA form + pickup window email within 2 business hours.

emily: Closing loop here for now — updating incident with next steps. Will reopen thread when docs come in. :eyes:
